coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:a4530093-6.description: Be Part of Our Next Chapter For over almost 60 years, our solutions have enabled impactful connections between some of the world’s leading brands and their customers. And while we’ve already done a lot of work we’re proud of, we’re just getting started! We’re a global technology company focused on creating dynamic, smart, personalized and engaging customer experiences powered by our range of digital hardware, our proprietary content management system and our industry leading signage solutions. (For example: If you’ve ordered in-store or in the drive-thru at McDonald’s somewhere in the world in the last few years, chances are you’ve interacted with our digital solutions.) We work in over 50 global markets and have 9 offices around the world, with a global headquarters proudly located in our founding home of Sydney, Australia. Coates Group has the values of a family-owned business and the innovative spirit of a start-up, both which fuel our purpose – Creating Connections. Empowering Partnerships. Always Evolving. Through hard work, dedication and creativity, we’ve become industry leaders who have won awards and set records while remaining focused on continual growth and evolution. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history. We are curious, charismatic, authentic and we value and leverage the diversity of our crew. We are imaginers, kindness enthusiasts, experts, creators, thinkers, challengers, collaborators and over-achievers. And together, as a Crew, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s leading brands leverage technology to drive the best customer experiences. The Director, Delivery is a leadership position responsible for overseeing the end-to-end delivery of software solutions to our clients. This role you will serve as the primary point of contact for NAM Tech client software-related engagements, ensuring that projects and initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with each client's and Coates’ strategic objectives.

Cross-functional Leadership: Exercise strategic influence across NAM Tech teams (Engineering, Content, Ops/DevOps, Deployment etc.) and client teams to coordinate seamless execution.
Risk & Issue Management: Identify risks early, create mitigation strategies, and drive the team to resolve solution delivery portfolio roadblocks with minimal impact.
Process Improvement: Lead the identification and implementation of improvements in project delivery processes to drive continuous improvement and scalability.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:b2.description: Our client is a family-owned and operated truck and trailer repair shop specializing in dedicated fleet maintenance, with a focus on the car hauling industry. They are fully equipped to handle all aspects of heavy-duty repair, offering top-tier diagnostic tools and a professional, supportive work environment. Our client is seeking a qualified Service Technician (Heavy-Duty) to perform professional repair and maintenance work on heavy-duty equipment. The technician will be responsible for diagnosing and servicing a wide range of mechanical and electrical systems on commercial trucks and equipment. This role includes performing diagnostics and maintenance on aftertreatment systems, disc and shoe brake systems, transmissions and clutches, suspension components, tires and wheels, air conditioning systems, as well as electrical and lighting systems. The ideal candidate will be capable of accurately diagnosing issues and completing repairs efficiently while maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety.

Utilize OEM diagnostic software and tools (Cummins, PACCAR, Snap-on, JPRO, ECT) to efficiently identify and resolve issues.
Maintain accurate records of work performed and communicate with fleet managers or clients as needed.

Maintain punctuality and professionalism at all times.

Complete tire and wheel maintenance, including inspections, replacements, and related repairs.
Diagnose and service air conditioning systems to ensure proper operation.
Troubleshoot and repair electrical systems and vehicle lighting.
Accurately document diagnostics, repairs, and completed work on service orders.
Follow company safety procedures and maintain a clean, organized work environment.
Communicate repair findings and recommendations with shop leadership or service management.
qualifications: Valid driver’s license
Previous experience performing repair and maintenance on heavy-duty trucks or equipment.
Strong ability to diagnose mechanical and electrical issues on commercial vehicles.
Experience working with aftertreatment systems, brake systems (disc and shoe), transmissions, clutches, suspension components, tires, and wheels.
Knowledge of air conditioning diagnostics and maintenance for heavy-duty equipment.
Ability to diagnose and repair electrical and lighting systems.
Familiarity with diesel engine systems and general heavy-duty truck components.
Ability to work independently and efficiently in a fast-paced shop environment.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Ability to properly document repairs and service work.

hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:8ab7f165-f414-49ab-875.title: AI Applied Researcher
hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:8ab7f165-f414-49ab-875.description: Full-time · On-site (Paris Marseille Amsterdam) The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer. Founded by Aymeric https://www.linkedin.com/in/adepontbriand/?locale=en (serial deeptech entrepreneur; founded & exited Scortex, Leading AI solution for manufacturing quality) and Gauthier https://www.linkedin.com/in/gauthier-bouxin/?locale=en (Navy officer and McKinsey), Pelagon is building a foundational multimodal acoustic model for autonomous maritime protection (underwater and surface) in service of European sovereignty. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats. France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Europe is still missing it’s naval NeoPrime, Pelagon aims to become to lead the way in autonomous marine protection—from detection to interception—partnering with leading navies, primes, and neo-primes, while also operating its own fleet as a service. Pelagon is backed by Hexa http://hexa.cc/, the pioneer startup studio in Europe, which has launched 35+ companies, including unicorns like Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, combining €230m+ ARR and €750m raised. Why this matters The sea is the physical layer of the economy — and Europe's most exposed flank. Submarines, drones and threats move through it unseen because the ocean is opaque by default. Pelagon exists to change that: to give Europe a real-time, sovereign understanding of what moves beneath the surface, from detection to interception. At the core of that mission is a maritime foundational perception model — Pelagon's equivalent of the perception stack that made autonomous driving possible, but for the underwater domain. As an AI Engineer, you own the models at the heart of it, from research to deployment on a distributed, autonomous fleet of UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys and seabed sensors. What you'll do - Design, train and ship state-of-the-art multimodal and acoustic models for underwater detection, classification and localization. - Build the training pipeline end to end: self-supervised pre-training on large unlabeled acoustic corpora, then fine-tuning for specific threats. - Fuse acoustic, kinematic and other sensor modalities into a single representation that holds up in low-SNR, real-world conditions. - Shape Pelagon's data strategy — how we capture, curate and compound proprietary data from our own fleet into a durable advantage. - Distill and optimize models to run on the edge: compute- and power-constrained hardware aboard autonomous vectors at sea. - Close the loop with sea trials — turn field data and failure cases into the next iteration. What we look for - Strong track record training models deployed in production, ideally on audio, signal, time-series or other non-image modalities. - A physical-AI mindset: you've worked where models meet messy sensor data and real hardware, not just clean benchmarks. - Instinct for data strategy — you treat the data flywheel as a core part of the model, not an afterthought. - Confortable across the ML stack: data, architecture, training, evaluation and deployment. Bias for shipping; you measure success by what works at sea. - Bonus: background in signal processing, or experience in defense, maritime, robotics or autonomous driving. Why join now - Founding ownership. You'll be one of the first engineers and will define the technical foundation of the company. Meaningful equity comes with that. - A mission with weight. This is hardware that protects critical infrastructure and Europe's maritime space. - Real things, in the real ocean, fast. You'll see your work in the water within weeks, not years. - AI-first, at the edge, in the real world.

hophr-hophr:lever:bce4d619-cc33-4712-aa8.description: The Senior Director, Physical Design & Backend Engineering is accountable for end-to-end backend execution across HPC SoC and MCU programs, including implementation, signoff, and convergence from RTL to GDS. This role leads globally distributed engineering teams and ensures delivery of high-quality silicon on schedule, meeting defined power, performance, and area (PPA) targets. The role operates at the intersection of execution, technology enablement, and organizational leadership, driving consistency, scalability, and reliability across multiple sites and concurrent programs.
responsibilities: 1. End-to-End Backend Execution
Own full lifecycle delivery from RTL through physical implementation, signoff, and tape-out.
Ensure predictable execution, design closure, and milestone adherence across all programs.
Drive first-pass silicon success through robust methodologies and execution discipline.
2. Global Team Leadership
Lead and scale large, geographically distributed backend engineering teams.
Establish clear accountability, performance standards, and delivery ownership across sites.
Build organizational capability to support multiple concurrent SoC and MCU programs.
3. PPA and Quality Accountability
Own delivery against defined power, performance, and area (PPA) targets.
Drive continuous improvement in cost, quality, and engineering efficiency.
Ensure adherence to quality standards, signoff criteria, and validation requirements.
4. Technology and Methodology Enablement
Enable adoption of advanced process nodes and associated design methodologies.
Drive improvements in tools, flows, and engineering practices across implementation and signoff.
Partner with foundries, EDA vendors, and internal teams to enhance design outcomes.
5. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with architecture, RTL, DFT, methodology, and product engineering teams.
Ensure alignment between architectural intent and physical implementation feasibility.
Support program execution through close collaboration with program and product leadership.
6. Organizational Execution and Scaling
Standardize ways of working across global teams to reduce variability and improve predictability.
Drive data-driven execution using metrics, KPIs, and performance tracking.
Identify and remove bottlenecks impacting delivery timelines or quality.
Scope and Impact
Responsible for backend execution across multiple SoC and MCU programs.
Direct leadership of large, multi-site engineering teams.
Critical impact on silicon delivery timelines, product quality, and business outcomes.
Key contributor to organizational execution capability and scalability within HPC.

redesignhealth-redesign-health:ashbyhq:3.description: ABOUT THE COMPANY: Redesign Health https://www.redesignhealth.com/ is a global venture and applied technology firm focused on building next-generation healthcare companies. We manage venture capital and venture buyout strategies, each powered by an AI operating system and a team of leading technologists, entrepreneurs, and investors drawn from the most consequential healthcare, AI, and software institutions in the world. Since 2018, Redesign and our portfolio companies have touched the lives of more than 15 million patients, raised over $1.5 billion from premier institutional, sovereign, and strategic investors, and built distinctive partnerships with marquee healthcare organizations and senior leaders around the world. We are headquartered in New York, with offices in Bengaluru, Los Angeles, and Riyadh. ABOUT THE TEAM: Redesign’s technology practice combines a frontier applied AI lab with deep healthtech investing expertise. Members of the practice have founded companies worth more than two billion dollars and built systems that serve hundreds of millions of patients, providers, and expert users, and run inside NASA, CIA, and 90% of the Fortune 500. The practice is responsible for Redesign’s technical investments, supports founders with architect-level guidance and more than a million dollars in AI and cloud credits, and builds the agentic operating system at the core of our business. Just as importantly, we help every team at Redesign use that system to become more technical, more creative, and more self-sufficient. We believe everyone is a builder, and that AI can let exceptional operators turn their expertise into software at the speed of thought. We are a team of founders and researchers, musicians and astrophysicists, caregivers and friends. We prize analytical rigor, intellectual humility, and a drive to learn, build, and teach. We have been working on language models since before they were large, but we still reinvent ourselves every day as technology changes how we work and collaborate. We believe that AI will do more good for humanity in healthcare than anywhere else. We know the most impactful member of our team will be someone we have not yet met, and we cannot wait to learn from them. ABOUT THE ROLE: We’re hiring a research-driven, product-minded Staff Product Designer to discover, design, and build the agentic products that power Redesign’s most important decisions: the founders we back, the concepts we pursue, the people we hire, the investors we work with, and the healthcare partners we support. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can sit with a user until they truly understand the work, translate that understanding into elegant product, and then build it themselves. You will own the full arc—from user research, to design, to shipping a working front end with AI-native tools, to the product judgment that decides what’s worth building at all. You will ship with the ownership of a founder, the empathy of a researcher, and the taste of a designer who sweats every detail. You keep current with frontier AI tooling and retool your tradecraft every day. You will join a global team of former founders, architects, and research scientists, and your peers will be among the most senior technical and business leaders at the firm. This is an IC role; you will lead through craft and influence rather than headcount. WHAT YOU'LL DO: - Go deep on the user. Embed with our investment, talent, and global development teams to understand high-judgment, often messy workflows from the inside. Run the research—interviews, observation, synthesis—that uncovers what people are really trying to do, and where today's tools fail them. Turn that insight into a clear, opinionated point of view—not on how to wrap tools around today's processes, but on how the work itself should change with the power of AI. - Design products people love. Take problems from ambiguous to shipped: information architecture, interaction design
